LLAgent.desc: LLAgent listener to (e.g.) teleport, sit, stand, etc.
LLAgent.name: LLAgent

ops.desc:
Return screen position of the ["avatar_id"] avatar or own avatar if not specified
reply contains "x", "y" coordinates and "onscreen" flag to indicate if it's actually in within the current window
avatar render position is used as the point
ops.name: getAgentScreenPos

ops.desc: Return information about ["item_id"] animation
ops.name: getAnimationInfo

ops.desc:
Send information about current state of the autopilot system to ["reply"]:
["enabled"]: boolean indicating whether or not autopilot is enabled
["target_global"]: array of target global {x, y, z} position
["leader_id"]: uuid of target autopilot is following
["stop_distance"]: maximum stop distance from target
["target_distance"]: last known distance from target
["use_rotation"]: boolean indicating if autopilot has a target facing rotation
["target_facing"]: array of {x, y} target direction to face
["rotation_threshold"]: target maximum angle from target facing rotation
["behavior_name"]: name of the autopilot behavior
ops.name: getAutoPilot

ops.desc:
Send information about the agent's groups on ["reply"]:
["groups"]: array of group information
["id"]: group id
["name"]: group name
["insignia"]: group insignia texture id
["notices"]: boolean indicating if this user accepts notices from this group
["display"]: boolean indicating if this group is listed in the user's profile
["contrib"]: user's land contribution to this group
ops.name: getGroups

ops.desc: Return your own avatar ID
ops.name: getID

ops.desc:
Return result set key ["result"] for nearby avatars in a range of ["dist"]
if ["dist"] is not specified, 'RenderFarClip' setting is used
reply contains "result" table with "id", "name", "global_pos", "region_pos", "region_id" fields
ops.name: getNearbyAvatarsList

ops.desc:
Return result set key ["result"] for nearby objects in a range of ["dist"]
if ["dist"] is not specified, 'RenderFarClip' setting is used
reply contains "result" table with "id", "global_pos", "region_pos", "region_id" fields
ops.name: getNearbyObjectsList

ops.desc:
Send information about the agent's position and orientation on ["reply"]:
["region"]: array of region {x, y, z} position
["global"]: array of global {x, y, z} position
["euler"]: map of {roll, pitch, yaw}
["quat"]:  array of [x, y, z, w] quaternion values
ops.name: getPosition

ops.desc:
["type"]: number to indicate the lookAt type, 0 to clear
["obj_uuid"]: id of object to look at, use this or ["position"] to indicate the target
["position"]: region position {x, y, z} where to find closest object or avatar to look at
ops.name: lookAt

ops.desc: Play ["item_id"] animation locally (by default) or ["inworld"] (when set to true)
ops.name: playAnimation

ops.desc: Reset Follow camera params
ops.name: removeCameraParams

ops.desc: ["obj_uuid"]: id of object to sit on, use this or ["position"] to indicate the sit target["position"]: region position {x, y, z} where to find closest object to sit on
ops.name: requestSit

ops.desc: Ask to stand up
ops.name: requestStand

ops.desc:
Teleport: ["regionname"], ["x"], ["y"], ["z"]
If ["skip_confirmation"] is true, use LLURLDispatcher rather than LLCommandDispatcher.
ops.name: requestTeleport

ops.desc: ["obj_uuid"]: id of object to touch, use this or ["position"] to indicate the object to touch["position"]: region position {x, y, z} where to find closest object to touch["face"]: optional object face number to touch[Default: 0]
ops.name: requestTouch

ops.desc: Set the agent to a fixed orientation (optionally specify ["lookat"] = array of [x, y, z])
ops.name: resetAxes

ops.desc:
Update target for currently running autopilot:
["target_global"]: array of target global {x, y, z} position
ops.name: setAutoPilotTarget

ops.desc:
Set Follow camera params, and then activate it:
["camera_pos"]: vector3, camera position in region coordinates
["focus_pos"]: vector3, what the camera is aimed at (in region coordinates)
["focus_offset"]: vector3, adjusts the camera focus position relative to the target, default is (1, 0, 0)
["distance"]: float (meters), distance the camera wants to be from its target, default is 3
["focus_threshold"]: float (meters), sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's target position within which its focus is not affected by target motion, default is 1
["camera_threshold"]: float (meters), sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's ideal position within which it is not affected by target motion, default is 1
["focus_lag"]: float (seconds), how much the camera lags as it tries to aim towards the target, default is 0.1
["camera_lag"]: float (seconds), how much the camera lags as it tries to move towards its 'ideal' position, default is 0.1
["camera_pitch"]: float (degrees), adjusts the angular amount that the camera aims straight ahead vs. straight down, maintaining the same distance, default is 0
["behindness_angle"]: float (degrees), sets the angle in degrees within which the camera is not constrained by changes in target rotation, default is 10
["behindness_lag"]: float (seconds), sets how strongly the camera is forced to stay behind the target if outside of behindness angle, default is 0
["camera_locked"]: bool, locks the camera position so it will not move
["focus_locked"]: bool, locks the camera focus so it will not move
ops.name: setCameraParams

ops.desc: Turns on or off scripted control of the camera using boolean ["active"]
ops.name: setFollowCamActive

ops.desc:
Start the autopilot system using the following parameters:
["target_global"]: array of target global {x, y, z} position
["stop_distance"]: maximum stop distance from target [default: autopilot guess]
["target_rotation"]: array of [x, y, z, w] quaternion values [default: no target]
["rotation_threshold"]: target maximum angle from target facing rotation [default: 0.03 radians]
["behavior_name"]: name of the autopilot behavior [default: ""]
["allow_flying"]: allow flying during autopilot [default: True]
event with ["success"] flag is sent to 'LLAutopilot' event pump, when auto pilot is terminated
ops.name: startAutoPilot

ops.desc:
["leader_id"]: uuid of target to follow using the autopilot system (optional with avatar_name)
["avatar_name"]: avatar name to follow using the autopilot system (optional with leader_id)
["allow_flying"]: allow flying during autopilot [default: True]
["stop_distance"]: maximum stop distance from target [default: autopilot guess]
ops.name: startFollowPilot

ops.desc: Stop playing ["item_id"] animation
ops.name: stopAnimation

ops.desc:
Stop the autopilot system:
["user_cancel"] indicates whether or not to act as though user canceled autopilot [default: false]
ops.name: stopAutoPilot

ops.desc: Quit abruptly
ops.name: forceQuit

ops.desc: Ask to quit nicely
ops.name: requestQuit

ops.desc:
Forward to ["pump"] future notifications on channel ["channel"]
according to boolean ["forward"]. When enabled, only types matching
["types"] are forwarded, as follows:
omitted or undefined: forward all notifications
string: forward only the specific named [sig]type
array of string: forward any notification matching any named [sig]type.
When boolean ["respond"] is true, we auto-respond to each forwarded
notification.
ops.name: forward

ops.desc:
Ignore future notification ["name"]
(from <notification name= > in notifications.xml)
according to boolean ["ignore"].
If ["name"] is omitted or undefined, [un]ignore all future notifications.
Note that ignored notifications are not forwarded unless intercepted before
the "Ignore" channel.
ops.name: ignore

ops.desc:
Given ["keysym"], ["keycode"] or ["char"], inject the specified keypress event.
(integer keycode values, or keysym string from any addKeyName() call in
https://github.com/secondlife/viewer/blob/develop/indra/llwindow/llkeyboard.cpp )

"SHIFT" or "MAC_CONTROL"; the corresponding modifier bits will be combined
to form the mask used with the event.
ops.name: keyDown

ops.desc:
Given ["keysym"], ["keycode"] or ["char"], inject the specified key release event.
(integer keycode values, or keysym string from any addKeyName() call in
https://github.com/secondlife/viewer/blob/develop/indra/llwindow/llkeyboard.cpp )
Specify optional ["mask"] as an array containing any of "CTL", "ALT",
"SHIFT" or "MAC_CONTROL"; the corresponding modifier bits will be combined
to form the mask used with the event.
ops.name: keyUp

ops.desc:
Given ["button"], optional ["path"], optional ["x"] and ["y"], inject the requested mouse click event.
(button values "LEFT", "MIDDLE", "RIGHT")
["path"] is as for LLUI::getInstance()->resolvePath(), described in
https://github.com/secondlife/viewer/blob/develop/indra/llui/llui.h
If you omit ["path"], you must specify both ["x"] and ["y"].
If you specify ["path"] without both ["x"] and ["y"], will synthesize (x, y)
in the center of the LLView selected by ["path"].
You may specify ["path"] with both ["x"] and ["y"], will use your (x, y).
This may cause the LLView selected by ["path"] to reject the event.
Optional ["reply"] requests a reply event on the named LLEventPump.
reply["error"] isUndefined (None) on success, else an explanatory message.
Specify optional ["mask"] as an array containing any of "CTL", "ALT",
"SHIFT" or "MAC_CONTROL"; the corresponding modifier bits will be combined
to form the mask used with the event.
ops.name: mouseDown

ops.desc:
Given optional ["path"], optional ["x"] and ["y"], inject the requested mouse movement event.
["path"] is as for LLUI::getInstance()->resolvePath(), described in
https://github.com/secondlife/viewer/blob/develop/indra/llui/llui.h
If you omit ["path"], you must specify both ["x"] and ["y"].
If you specify ["path"] without both ["x"] and ["y"], will synthesize (x, y)
in the center of the LLView selected by ["path"].
You may specify ["path"] with both ["x"] and ["y"], will use your (x, y).
This may cause the LLView selected by ["path"] to reject the event.
Optional ["reply"] requests a reply event on the named LLEventPump.
reply["error"] isUndefined (None) on success, else an explanatory message.
Specify optional ["mask"] as an array containing any of "CTL", "ALT",
"SHIFT" or "MAC_CONTROL"; the corresponding modifier bits will be combined
to form the mask used with the event.
ops.name: mouseMove

ops.desc:
Given an integer number of ["clicks"], inject the requested mouse scroll event.
(positive clicks moves downward through typical content)
ops.name: mouseScroll

ops.desc:
Given ["button"], optional ["path"], optional ["x"] and ["y"], inject the requested mouse release event.
(button values "LEFT", "MIDDLE", "RIGHT")
["path"] is as for LLUI::getInstance()->resolvePath(), described in
https://github.com/secondlife/viewer/blob/develop/indra/llui/llui.h
If you omit ["path"], you must specify both ["x"] and ["y"].
If you specify ["path"] without both ["x"] and ["y"], will synthesize (x, y)
in the center of the LLView selected by ["path"].
You may specify ["path"] with both ["x"] and ["y"], will use your (x, y).
This may cause the LLView selected by ["path"] to reject the event.
Optional ["reply"] requests a reply event on the named LLEventPump.
reply["error"] isUndefined (None) on success, else an explanatory message.
Specify optional ["mask"] as an array containing any of "CTL", "ALT",
"SHIFT" or "MAC_CONTROL"; the corresponding modifier bits will be combined
to form the mask used with the event.
ops.name: mouseUp
